heat_formula: heat = 10*ln(1+E) + 8*ln(1+N) + 3*log10(1+S); E = likes + 2*reposts + 3*quotes + replies + bookmarks summed over distinct sampled X posts mentioning the skill in the trailing 7 days; N = number of those posts; S = GitHub stars (0 if unknown). Category heat = sum of skill heat. x_posts_7d (X recent-count for the top skills' queries) is reported separately and not in heat, because it is only fetched for the top-N skills.
